subject: Temporary invoice sender during portal roll-in — VAT evidence & AP copy
messages:
From: Liam O'Connor <liam.oconnor@grynk.com>
To: Sean Gallagher <sean.gallagher@redwood.ai>
Cc: AP Accounts <ap-payments@grynk.com>
Date: 2025-06-03T09:12:00-07:00
Subject: Who sends invoices while we enroll to the portal?

Hi Sean,

We're starting the AP onboarding for Redwood this week — our procurement tool says you should pick who will be the invoice sender while Grynk completes the portal enrollment. A couple of questions to confirm: 

- Do you want Redwood to send the invoices by email for the first two cycles and then switch to portal push?
- How should VAT evidence (PDF of VAT certificate / tax form) be shared so our AP team can reconcile?
- Please BCC ap-payments@grynk.com on the initial invoices so they can verify formatting against our PO.

I attached the signed SoW for reference.

Thanks,
Liam
Liam O'Connor
Head of Finance Ops
Grynk Health

Attachment: signed-sow.pdf (application/pdf, 184KB)

From: Sean Gallagher <sean.gallagher@redwood.ai>
To: Liam O'Connor <liam.oconnor@grynk.com>
Cc: Kimberly Park <kimberly.park@redwood.ai>, Olga Petrov <olga.petrov@redwood.ai>
Date: 2025-06-03T11:05:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Who sends invoices while we enroll to the portal?

Hi Liam — thanks, and congrats on getting the AP side started. Short answer: we can run a temporary email-based sender for the first two invoices and then flip to portal pushes once your token is active. Proposed plan below: 

1) Initial two invoices: Redwood will email invoice PDFs to ap-payments@grynk.com and cc the primary billing contact you confirm below. I'll BCC our finance mailbox for records.
2) VAT evidence: we will attach a PDF VAT certificate to the invoice email and also upload it to the secure folder in the shared Drive link.
3) Switch-over: once your portal token is provisioned (we'll track via the portal-enroll ticket), we'll change the sender to portal push and stop emailing copies (we can keep an emailed copy for one additional cycle if you prefer).

Action items for Grynk: 
- Confirm the billing contact name & email to be listed on the invoice.
- Share VAT registration number (and attach VAT certificate if handy).
- Confirm you want exactly two cycles by email or a single cycle as a trial.

I've attached our invoice template so you can confirm formatting (pdf layout and required fields).

Cheers,
Sean Gallagher
Account Executive | Redwood Inference
sean.gallagher@redwood.ai | +1 415-555-0192

Attachment: invoice-template-Redwood.xlsx (spreadsheet, 42KB)

Date: 2025-06-04T08:33:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Who sends invoices while we enroll to the portal?

Hi all — operational notes from finance/ops side: 

- We are fine with Redwood emailing PDFs for two cycles. Suggested defaults:
  • Sender: invoices@redwood.ai (helps AP auto-ingest).
  • Include: Invoice PDF + VAT certificate PDF attached + invoice metadata in email body (invoice number, period, net/gross, VAT breakdown).
  • BCC: finance-ops@redwood.ai for our archive.

- Portal enrollment: once Grynk's token is set, we'll enable portal push. We will retain a one-cycle email copy for your AP team if you want for reconciliation, but it's optional.

- PO exceptions: if Grynk requires the invoice to list a third-party remit or alternate bill-to, please confirm now so we can template correctly.

Attaching a short portal-enroll checklist that I recommend we follow (fields we need from Grynk + expected turnaround).

Kimberly Park
Revenue Ops Manager | Redwood Inference
kimberly.park@redwood.ai

Attachment: portal-enroll-checklist.xlsx (spreadsheet, 18KB)

Thanks Sean and Kimberly — that plan works for us. Confirmations below: 

- Billing contact to show on invoices: Nora Blake <nora.blake@grynk.com>
- VAT registration: IE1234567A (certificate attached here from our side)
- Please send the first two invoice PDFs to ap-payments@grynk.com and CC Nora. After the portal token is live, please switch to portal push and keep one emailed copy for our records (optional).

Liam
